T: Get that corn out of my face. Eat this instead.
D: A monastery cook in Mexico secretly moonlights as a luchador to buy better food for the orphans.
P: Serve the mains when Nacho finally cooks the orphans a proper feast.
S: his tag-team partner snacking on the street
Corn tortillas cut into wedges, fried at 180C until crisp, tossed in salt, lime and chilli, with a fresh tomato salsa.
the crowd at the lucha libre arena
Corn grilled until charred, rolled in mayo and lime, covered in crumbled feta, chilli powder and coriander.
the plain food Nacho is stuck serving

Crisp fried tostadas spread with garlicky refried black beans, topped with queso fresco, shredded lettuce, pickled onion, salsa roja and a drizzle of crema. Fry 8 corn tortillas in 180C oil for 1 minute a side until crisp, then drain. Fry a diced onion and 2 garlic cloves in oil, add 2 drained cans of black beans and mash with a splash of water until thick. Slice a red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 15 minutes. Spread the beans on the tostadas and top with shredded iceberg, 150g crumbled feta, pickled onion, salsa and sour cream.
M: the proper feast he buys with his winnings
Chorizo and potato cooked crisp in a hot pan with onion and chilli, in warm corn tortillas with avocado, pickled onion and coriander.
Oaxaca chicken mole with sesame rice
the Oaxaca town where Nacho cooks for the orphans

Chicken thighs simmered in a mole of dried chillies, tomato, garlic, cinnamon, almonds and dark chocolate blitzed smooth, served with rice and toasted sesame. Toast 4 dried ancho chillies in a dry pan, then soak in 500ml hot chicken stock for 20 minutes. Fry a chopped onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tomatoes, 50g almonds, 1 tsp cinnamon and the chillies with their stock, and blitz smooth with 40g dark chocolate. Brown 1kg chicken thighs, pour over the mole and simmer covered for 40 minutes. Serve over steamed rice with toasted sesame seeds.
W: the better food Nacho fights for the orphans to have

Choux dough piped into hot oil and fried golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served hot with a warm dark chocolate dipping sauce. Bring 250ml water, 60g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, then beat in 150g plain flour until it leaves the sides of the pan. Cool 5 minutes and beat in 2 eggs one at a time. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into 180C oil and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 100g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 100ml cream and serve warm for dipping.
K: a sweet rice drink for the kids
Rice and cinnamon soaked overnight in water, blitzed, strained, sweetened, mixed with milk and served over ice.

s.note: his tag-team partner snacking on the street
s.how: Cut 12 corn tortillas into wedges and fry at 180C until crisp, then toss in salt, lime zest and chilli powder. Dice 4 tomatoes and half a white onion and mix with lime juice and salt for a fresh salsa. Serve the chips warm with the salsa.

s.note: the crowd at the lucha libre arena
s.how: Grill 4 corn cobs over high heat until charred all over. Brush with mayonnaise mixed with lime juice. Roll in crumbled feta, then sprinkle with chilli powder and chopped coriander. Serve hot with lime wedges for squeezing over at the table.

m.note: the proper feast he buys with his winnings
m.how: Dice 2 chorizo and 400g potatoes and fry with a sliced white onion and a little chilli until crisp and golden. Quickly pickle more sliced onion in lime juice. Spoon into warm corn tortillas with sliced avocado, pickled onion and coriander.

w.note: the better food Nacho fights for the orphans to have
w.how: Bring 250ml water, 60g butter and a pinch of salt to the boil, then beat in 150g plain flour until it leaves the sides of the pan. Cool 5 minutes and beat in 2 eggs one at a time. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into 180C oil and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 100g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Melt 150g dark chocolate with 100ml cream and serve warm for dipping.

d.note: a sweet rice drink for the kids
d.how: Soak 200g long grain rice and 2 cinnamon sticks in 1L water overnight. Blend until smooth, then strain through a fine cloth. Stir in 100g sugar and 250ml milk until dissolved. Chill well and pour over ice with a pinch of cinnamon on top.
